question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The act of transferring one's authority to another
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delegation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Delegation"** refers to the act of transferring one's authority or responsibility to another person or group. (प्रतिनिधित्व या अधिकार सौंपना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager made a delegation of tasks to the team leaders to ensure timely project completion.
 
 
 
• **"Authority transfer"** involves assigning responsibilities or powers from one person to another, often seen in workplaces or organizational structures. (अधिकार हस्तांतरण)
 
 
• **Example:** Delegation of authority is crucial for effective management in large organizations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delegation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mediary** (मध्यस्थ): A person or organization that acts as an intermediary or go-between for two parties.

 
 
• **Example:** The mediary helped resolve the dispute between the two companies.
 
 
 
• **Agency** (संस्था ): An organization or business that provides a particular service or represents another.
 
 
• **Example:** The travel agency arranged our entire trip to Europe.
 
 
 
• **Assignee** (प्रत्यायित व्यक्ति): A person to whom rights, responsibilities, or properties are transferred.
 
 
• **Example:** The assignee will handle the estate after the owner's demise.
